data.title: DIAGNOS to Hold its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on September 30, 2026
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Diagnos Inc. ("DIAGNOS") disclosed plans for its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders to take place on September 30, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., at Alt Quartier DIX30 Hotel in Brossard, Quebec. The corporation, known for its employment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the early detection of eye-related health issues, will convene to address key agendas. Shareholders and stakeholders can attend in person at the specified location: 6500 de Rome Blvd, 2nd floor, Brossard, QC, J4Y 0B6. DIAGNOS trades on the TSX Venture exchange under the symbol ADK, on the OTCQB as DGNOF, and on the FWB as 4D4A.
FAQs regarding reorganization scheduled for September 2026 are now available to the public.

data.title: Wealth.com Brings Estate and Tax Planning Into Claude for Financial Advisors
data.description: Wealth.com, a prominent estate and tax planning platform for wealth management firms, has revealed its role as a launch partner for Claude for Financial Advisors. This collaboration comes as estate and tax planning require precise attention, with queries on trust benefits, authority in health care directives, and the financial implications of tax strategies needing accurate solutions based on legal documents and quantitative data. Wealth.com is at the forefront of this initiative to enhance advisor workflows in addressing these crucial aspects.

data.title: The Estée Lauder Companies Announces Partnership with Profound to Expand AI Visibility Across Its Global Brand Portfolio
data.description: In New York, The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) revealed a new worldwide strategic collaboration with Profound, the pioneering AI marketing platform. This move is aimed at bolstering the company's goal of becoming the top player in AI-driven exploration within prestige beauty. Through this partnership, The Estée Lauder Companies will gain insights into the presence of its entire brand lineup on key generative AI platforms and explore possibilities to enhance this presence. By teaming up with Profound, the company aims to solidify its position as a leader in AI-powered discovery within the beauty industry.

data.title: Solana (SOL) reaches 30 months with 100% uptime, showing strong resilience with increasing transactions.
data.description: Solana's blockchain network, known for its high reliability, recently reached an impressive milestone by operating continuously for 30 months without any outage. During this period, the network has demonstrated its robustness by efficiently processing record transaction volumes. This achievement further solidifies Solana's position as a trusted platform for secure and seamless transactions.

data.title: Foreign A.I. concerns spark fears of bioweapons race. Experts caution against using chatbots for lethal pathogens. New safeguards necessary.
data.description: According to experts, current chatbots are not expected to assist individuals in creating a lethal pathogen. However, with advancements in training these bots in biology, there is a growing concern for potential risks. It is suggested that these newer models may require enhanced safety measures to prevent misuse. This highlights the importance of ensuring appropriate safeguards are in place as technology progresses in this field.
